title: Lesson 87: Exam prep: Application and Platform Architect domains review
description: Three applied questions on reading the architect exam guides as scope documents: the highest weighted section of the Sharing and Visibility exam, the Implications of Security Model Choice objectives, and the prerequisite exam set that grants the System Architect credential.

questions.question: A candidate has four weeks left before sitting the Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect exam and can only finish one outline section properly. The published outline weights four sections. Which one carries the most marks?
options: Permissions to standard objects, custom objects and fields
questions.explanation: Access to Records carries 39 percent of the exam, the single largest section in the outline, which is why the lesson treats the record access objectives as the ladder that answers most items. The permissions section carries 27 percent, Access to Other Data covers files, reports, dashboards and big objects at 16 percent, and Implications of Security Model Choice carries 18 percent. Choosing the largest section when time is short follows the weights rather than a candidate's comfort zone.

questions.question: A scenario item on the Sharing and Visibility exam describes a partner population, several hundred thousand records in the shared objects, and a bulk data load scheduled for the same weekend as go-live. The item belongs to the Implications of Security Model Choice section. Which three things must a scoring answer name?
options: The record access override, the sharing rule type, and the role hierarchy depth
The profile permissions, the permission set groups, and the login IP ranges
The scalability implications of the sharing solution, the license limitations that will impact the intended sharing solution, and how to test the sharing model
The object relationship type, the external identifier field, and the migration tool
questions.explanation: That section asks candidates to determine the scalability implications of the sharing solution, the license limitations that will impact the intended sharing solution, and how to test the sharing model. The lesson calls it the section candidates forget, and it is 18 percent of the exam. Notice that the volume figure and the concurrent bulk load in the scenario are both there to be used, because sharing recalculation over a large load is a scalability answer.

questions.question: A candidate holds Platform Developer, Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect, Platform Identity and Access Management Architect and Platform Integration Architect. Which credential is granted by those four exams together?
questions.explanation: System Architect is granted once Platform Developer, Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect, Platform Identity and Access Management Architect and Platform Integration Architect are completed. Application Architect is a different set: Platform App Builder, Platform Data Architect, Platform Developer and Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect. Technical Architect sits above both, requiring the Architect Review Board Evaluation plus those two credentials.
